task_description: Implement the route-suggestions feature: ORS round-trip routing -> suggestRoute service -> cached suggested_routes, surfaced via a standalone /routes UI, a suggestRoute coach tool, and a reusable map/summary component with a documented export hook for later plan integration. Covers spec Phases 1-5, 7 (env/docs), 8 (tests). Phase 6 is skipped except the reusable component + export hook (plan view is a stub). Migration authored but not run; mobile-first; typed tool only (no MCP); gotcha #36 tool-schema rules.
